changes.comment: sdk-ui-dashboard: Keep the filters a user may not read in an existing automation they save, and report them in the automation filter bar as one removable entry that is never named. A new automation never stores such a filter.
sdk-ui-dashboard: Rename selectDashboardFiltersWithoutCrossFiltering to selectExecutableDashboardFiltersWithoutCrossFiltering, so its name says that the filters the user may not read are left out.
